text.tspan: Check for rule drop or routing gap
Edge CLI: vrf then get bgp neighbor summary
Check TEP vmkernel IP and route
Check cluster quorum: get cluster status
Check disk and memory on the Manager VM
Identify rule ID and section in NSX policy
Check Edge port counters: get physical-port
Verify BGP peers: get bgp neighbor summary
vsipioctl getstats -f filter-name to see rule hit
vsipioctl getaddrsets for security group members
esxcli network ip interface ipv4 get to verify TEP IP
Review alarm source and recommended action
